President Donald Trump promised to put a "tremendous tax" on companies that build data centers outside of the US, even as states and cities around the country are placing restrictions on new applications to build them.

"We're not going to allow our companies to build data centers outside of our country," Trump said at a press conference Friday following his summit with China President Xi Jinping and Russia President Vladimir Putin. "They allowed that to happen with chips and everything else, and it was very destructive to our country. It's where we started going behind."
